gloss: scrap of paper; slip of paper

definitions.gloss: scrap of paper; slip of paper
definitions.explanation: A small or insignificant piece of paper. Can be neutral (a memo or note) or dismissive (implying something is worthless).

examples.japanese: {紙切|かみき}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メモした→メモする：25501_memosuru⟧。
examples.english: I jotted it down on a scrap of paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{紙切|かみき}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: A slip of paper came out of my pocket.

examples.japanese: ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紙切|かみき}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: A contract like this is nothing more than a worthless piece of paper.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧ (paper) + {切|き}れ (piece, scrap). The suffix 〜{切|き}れ indicates a small fragment cut or torn from something larger.

When used literally, it simply means a small piece of paper. When used figuratively — especially with ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紙切|かみき}れ — it dismisses something (a document, certificate, or contract) as worthless or meaningless.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紙切|かみき}れ: just a scrap of paper (dismissive)
- ⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紙切|かみき}れ: a single piece of paper
- {紙切|かみき}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない: nothing more than a piece of paper

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{端切|はぎ}れ→端切れ：24305_hagire⟧: remnant, scrap — leftover fabric from cutting
